state.scope: Plan review for a deterministic local research-ledger adapter. No code or private documents transmitted. Two public Republic campaigns, Phantom Phood and Stock Card, already have exact-matrix independent source review and final factual JEV acceptance.
state.method: Restrict the adapter to those two exact approved rows. Pin the matrix, decision, independent review, public original source bytes and source-field anchors by SHA-256. Reject changed or missing artifacts, extra rows, stale decisions, absent review, source/ID/date mismatches and duplicate representations. Preserve sequential stages: source integrity, company identity, observed economic round, launch/completion, aggregate funding, field classification, then canonical local research admission. Later outcome/census unknowns do not erase earlier accepted stages.
state.data_scope: Canonical records use valuation_cap=null and comparable_valuation=null; original offered SAFE caps remain a separately named amount with original-source hash, page/anchor and scope. Preserve Phantom's three amount displays and conditional possible concurrent-financing uncertainty. No-positive-cohost evidence is bounded, not absence proof; do not fabricate graph bridges.
state.outputs: Atomic nonoverwrite versioned local canonical research ledger with two admitted observed Layer B research rows, plus stage and unresolved ledgers. Production admission, estimation eligibility, rates, priors, full historical coverage, global plateau and phase completion all stay false. Deterministic replay must be identical; independently review frozen code/input/output hashes before release acceptance.
state.testing: Adversarial changes to all approval/source hashes, extra rows, missed medium-identity review, intermediary/issuer scope, pending/failed or template-only funding, date substitutions, prior-year launch, cap-as-priced-value, cohost absence, duplicate records and writes to existing nonidentical output. This narrow adapter authenticates bound upstream semantic review; it is not a generic automated source-proof engine.

criteria.implement_verify_bounded_adapter: Implement and independently verify this exact-row, fail-closed, non-promotional research adapter.
criteria.generic_mass_promotion: Generalize immediately to all discovered rows based on native state alone.
criteria.block_all: Reject all local research admission despite upstream factual acceptance.

stage_separation.instructions: Should canonical local research admission remain separate from census completeness, outcomes, estimation and production promotion?

criteria.true: Separate accepted early facts and unresolved downstream gates.
criteria.false: Set downstream completion gates true when the two rows are admitted.
